ROOT = Path("/Users/teilomillet/Code/wyat")
OUT = Path("/private/tmp/wyat-cuda-latency-package-check")
RECEIPT = ROOT / "benchmarks/real/package-cuda-latency-verification.json"
TOOLING_AUDIT = ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/cuda-latency-local-review.json"
TOOLING_RECEIPT = ROOT / "benchmarks/real/engine-cuda-latency-verification.json"
AUDIT_SHA256 = "58b44eeb4864c57f6b9ee8a60aeb1f6977a529c4e6adfd820cc891601e5590d0"
DECLARATION = (
    ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/cuda-latency-source-declaration-20261005.json"
)
DECLARATION_SHA256 = "a26d5be45598c29e9fe6f1a0d0e620c22d0101f060eda730274d404498c7a0a4"
TOOLING_RECEIPT_SHA256 = (
    "67930b46739fdd3f35fbc00c425bdee3879c2008dc3a3ee57c51ae1893bc7cdf"
)
EXPECTED_WHEEL_SHA256 = (
    "3c2397b691e1568c11c0ace0866b2ee5da36903f1198dfc3bb0b345a09ab3360"
)
RELOCATION = ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/cuda-fp32-b1-audit-relocation.json"
BUILD = [
    "/Users/teilomillet/.local/bin/uv",
    "build",
    "--offline",
    "--cache-dir",
    "/private/tmp/wyat-uv-build-cache",
    "--python",
    str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/python"),
    "--no-python-downloads",
    "--out-dir",
    str(OUT),
    "--no-create-gitignore",
    str(ROOT),
]

    "benchmarks/analysis/cuda/latency/__init__.py",
    "benchmarks/analysis/cuda/latency/run.py",
    "benchmarks/analysis/cuda/latency/study.py",

ISOLATED = """from __future__ import annotations
import json
import sys
from collections.abc import Sequence
import wyat
import wyat.interop.dmbench
from wyat.core import Candidate, Model, Request
from wyat.evaluation import EvaluationCase, evaluate

class ControlledScorer:
    def score_many(self, requests: Sequence[Request]) -> tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...]:
        return tuple((0.0, 1.0) for _ in requests)

request = Request('question', (Candidate('a', 'first'), Candidate('b', 'second')))
model = Model(ControlledScorer(), 'package-check')
decision = model.decide(request)
assert decision.selected == 'b'
assert evaluate(model, (EvaluationCase('one', request, ('b',)),)).accuracy == 1.0
blocked = {'torch', 'mlx', 'mlx_lm', 'transformers', 'huggingface_hub',
           'fastapi', 'dmbench', 'safetensors'}
assert not blocked.intersection(name.split('.')[0] for name in sys.modules)
print(json.dumps({'wyat_path': wyat.__file__, 'selected': decision.selected,
                  'forbidden_import_roots': sorted(blocked),
                  'forbidden_imports_present': []}))
"""


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return sha(path.read_bytes())


def inventory(paths: list[Path]) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): digest(path) for path in sorted(paths)}


def source_paths() -> list[Path]:
    return [
        path
        for directory in ("wyat", "benchmarks", "tests")
        for path in (ROOT / directory).rglob("*.py")
        if not forbidden(str(path))
    ]


def evidence_paths() -> list[Path]:
    result_root = ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results"
    return sorted(
        {
            path
            for pattern in ("cuda-latency*", "cuda-profile-cost*")
            for path in result_root.glob(pattern)
            if path.is_file() and path.suffix in {".json", ".txt"}
        }
    )


def document_paths() -> list[Path]:
    documents = [
        ROOT / "pyproject.toml",
        ROOT / "README.md",
        ROOT / "NOTICE",
        ROOT / "LICENSE",
        ROOT / "open-question.md",
        ROOT / "wyat/py.typed",
    ]
    documents.extend((ROOT / "docs").rglob("*.md"))
    documents.extend(evidence_paths())
    admitted_xml = ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/mlx-metal-first8-toc.xml"
    if admitted_xml.exists():
        documents.append(admitted_xml)
    if RELOCATION.exists():
        relocation = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(RELOCATION.read_bytes()))
        files = cast(list[dict[str, object]], relocation["files"])
        documents.append(RELOCATION)
        for entry in files:
            archive = ROOT / cast(str, entry["archive_path"])
            assert digest(archive) == entry["sha256"]
            assert archive.stat().st_size == entry["bytes"]
            documents.append(archive)
        review = cast(dict[str, str], relocation["immutable_review"])
        review_path = ROOT / review["path"]
        assert digest(review_path) == review["sha256"]
        documents.append(review_path)
    if TOOLING_AUDIT.exists():
        audit = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(TOOLING_AUDIT.read_bytes()))
        auditor = cast(dict[str, str], audit["source_archive"])
        auditor_path = Path(auditor["path"])
        assert digest(auditor_path) == auditor["sha256"]
        documents.extend((TOOLING_AUDIT, auditor_path, TOOLING_RECEIPT, DECLARATION))
        receipt = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(TOOLING_RECEIPT.read_bytes()))
        tooling_archive_record = cast(dict[str, str], receipt["source_archive"])
        tooling_archive_path = Path(tooling_archive_record["path"])
        assert digest(tooling_archive_path) == tooling_archive_record["sha256"]
        documents.append(tooling_archive_path)
    return documents


def forbidden(name: str) -> bool:
    path = Path(name)
    parts = path.parts
    return (
        any(part.endswith((".trace", ".gputrace")) for part in parts)
        or any(part in {".models", ".venv", "venv", "__pycache__"} for part in parts)
        or name.endswith(".raw.xml")
        or path.suffix.lower()
        in {
            ".safetensors",
            ".pt",
            ".pth",
            ".onnx",
            ".bin",
            ".pyc",
            ".pyo",
        }
    )


def command_record(result: subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]) -> dict[str, object]:
    return {
        "command": result.args,
        "exit_code": result.returncode,
        "stdout": result.stdout,
        "stderr": result.stderr,
    }


def main() -> None:
    if RECEIPT.exists() or OUT.exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Preserve prior receipts and build directories")
    script_checks: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for args in (
        [str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/ruff"), "check", __file__],
        [str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/ruff"), "format", "--check", __file__],
        [str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/mypy"), "--strict", "--follow-imports=skip", __file__],
    ):
        checked = subprocess.run(
            args, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30
        )
        script_checks.append(command_record(checked))
        assert checked.returncode == 0, checked.stdout + checked.stderr
    production = sorted((ROOT / "wyat").rglob("*.py"))
    expected = {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): path.read_bytes() for path in production}
    assert len(expected) == 20
    prior_path = ROOT / "benchmarks/real/package-engine-tooling-verification.json"
    prior = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(prior_path.read_text()))
    assert inventory(production) == prior["production_source_sha256"]
    assert digest(TOOLING_AUDIT) == AUDIT_SHA256
    tooling_audit = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(TOOLING_AUDIT.read_bytes()))
    assert tooling_audit["completed"] is True
    assert tooling_audit["source_gate_passed"] is True
    assert tooling_audit["declaration_sha256"] == DECLARATION_SHA256
    review_hashes = cast(dict[str, str], tooling_audit["source_sha256"])
    assert len(review_hashes) == 5
    assert inventory([ROOT / name for name in review_hashes]) == review_hashes
    for check in cast(list[dict[str, object]], tooling_audit["checks"]):
        assert check["exit_code"] == 0 and check["timed_out"] is False
        assert check["owned_group_reaped"] is True
    review_archive_record = cast(dict[str, str], tooling_audit["source_archive"])
    review_source_archive = Path(review_archive_record["path"])
    assert digest(review_source_archive) == review_archive_record["sha256"]
    reviewed = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(review_source_archive.read_bytes()))
    review_files = cast(list[dict[str, str]], reviewed["files"])
    assert len(review_files) == 5
    for review_entry in review_files:
        assert sha(review_entry["text"].encode()) == review_entry["sha256"]
        assert review_entry["sha256"] == review_hashes[review_entry["name"]]
    assert digest(TOOLING_RECEIPT) == TOOLING_RECEIPT_SHA256
    tooling = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(TOOLING_RECEIPT.read_bytes()))
    maintained = cast(dict[str, str], tooling["source_sha256"])
    assert len(maintained) == 133
    assert inventory([ROOT / name for name in maintained]) == maintained
    archive_record = cast(dict[str, str], tooling["source_archive"])
    source_archive = Path(archive_record["path"])
    assert digest(source_archive) == archive_record["sha256"]
    assert archive_record["sha256"] == (
        "ecf1b155858d04f1bb49af1313c054fe096806feeba15e413ec805b0cfffbeb4"
    )
    archive_values = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(source_archive.read_bytes()))
    archived_sources = cast(list[dict[str, str]], archive_values["files"])
    assert len(archived_sources) == 133
    assert {entry["path"] for entry in archived_sources} == maintained.keys()
    for source_entry in archived_sources:
        assert sha(source_entry["text"].encode()) == maintained[source_entry["path"]]
        assert source_entry["sha256"] == maintained[source_entry["path"]]
    assert digest(DECLARATION) == DECLARATION_SHA256
    declaration = cast(dict[str, str], json.loads(DECLARATION.read_bytes()))
    assert set(declaration) == {*LATENCY, "docs/analysis/latency.md"}
    assert {name: digest(ROOT / name) for name in LATENCY} == {
        name: declaration[name] for name in LATENCY
    }
    sources, documents = source_paths(), document_paths()
    before = inventory(sources + documents)
    for name in LATENCY:
        assert name in before
    preserved_paths = list((ROOT / "benchmarks/real").glob("package*verification*"))
    preserved_paths.extend(
        path for path in (ROOT / "dist").rglob("*") if path.is_file()
    )
    preserved = inventory(preserved_paths)
    OUT.mkdir()
    build = subprocess.run(BUILD, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    (OUT / "build.stdout").write_text(build.stdout)
    (OUT / "build.stderr").write_text(build.stderr)
    assert build.returncode == 0, build.stderr
    assert inventory(source_paths() + document_paths()) == before, (
        "Source changed during build"
    )
    assert inventory(preserved_paths) == preserved, "Historical bytes changed"
    (wheel,) = OUT.glob("*.whl")
    (sdist,) = OUT.glob("*.tar.gz")
    assert digest(wheel) == EXPECTED_WHEEL_SHA256
    checks: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel) as archive:
        wheel_names = archive.namelist()
        assert not [name for name in wheel_names if forbidden(name)]
        assert {
            name
            for name in wheel_names
            if name.startswith("wyat/") and name.endswith(".py")
        } == expected.keys()
        for name, data in expected.items():
            assert archive.read(name) == data, name
        assert archive.read("wyat/py.typed") == (ROOT / "wyat/py.typed").read_bytes()
        for name in ("NOTICE", "LICENSE"):
            (entry,) = (
                item for item in wheel_names if item.endswith("/licenses/" + name)
            )
            assert archive.read(entry) == (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(
            prefix="wyat-cuda-latency-isolated-", dir="/private/tmp"
        ) as isolated:
            archive.extractall(isolated)
            environment = {
                **os.environ,
                "PYTHONPATH": isolated,
                "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
            }
            for args in (
                [sys.executable, "-S", "-c", ISOLATED],
                [sys.executable, "-S", "-m", "wyat", "--help"],
            ):
                checked = subprocess.run(
                    args,
                    cwd=isolated,
                    env=environment,
                    capture_output=True,
                    text=True,
                    timeout=15,
                )
                checks.append(command_record(checked))
                assert checked.returncode == 0, checked.stderr
            assert "usage: wyat" in cast(str, checks[-1]["stdout"])
    with tarfile.open(sdist, "r:gz") as archive:
        members = archive.getnames()
        assert not [name for name in members if forbidden(name)]
        prefix = members[0].split("/")[0]
        for name, expected_hash in before.items():
            member = archive.extractfile(f"{prefix}/{name}")
            assert member is not None, name
            assert sha(member.read()) == expected_hash, name
    assert inventory(source_paths() + document_paths()) == before, (
        "Source changed during verification"
    )
    assert inventory(preserved_paths) == preserved, "Historical bytes changed"
    script = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
    archive_data: dict[str, object] = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "files": [
            {
                "name": "verification_script",
                "path": str(Path(__file__)),
                "sha256": sha(script),
                "text": script.decode("utf-8"),
            },
            {
                "name": "independent_review_source_archive",
                "path": str(review_source_archive),
                "sha256": digest(review_source_archive),
                "text": review_source_archive.read_text(),
            },
            {
                "name": "independent_tooling_audit",
                "path": str(TOOLING_AUDIT),
                "sha256": digest(TOOLING_AUDIT),
                "text": TOOLING_AUDIT.read_text(),
            },
            {
                "name": "study_source_declaration",
                "path": str(DECLARATION),
                "sha256": digest(DECLARATION),
                "text": DECLARATION.read_text(),
            },
            *[
                {
                    "name": name,
                    "path": str(ROOT / name),
                    "sha256": before[name],
                    "text": (ROOT / name).read_text(),
                }
                for name in LATENCY
            ],
        ],
    }
    archive_bytes = (
        json.dumps(archive_data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"
    ).encode()
    archive_hash = sha(archive_bytes)
    archive_name = f"package-cuda-latency-verification.sources-{archive_hash[:16]}.json"
    archive_path = ROOT / "benchmarks/real" / archive_name
    with archive_path.open("xb") as output:
        output.write(archive_bytes)
    record: dict[str, object] = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "scope": (
            "CPU-only offline local packaging verification; "
            "no publication or device/framework execution"
        ),
        "build": command_record(build),
        "wheel": {
            "path": str(wheel),
            "sha256": digest(wheel),
            "bytes": wheel.stat().st_size,
            "members": wheel_names,
        },
        "sdist": {
            "path": str(sdist),
            "sha256": digest(sdist),
            "bytes": sdist.stat().st_size,
            "member_count": len(members),
            "members": members,
        },
        "production_python_files": len(expected),
        "wheel_byte_identical_previous": True,
        "production_source_sha256": inventory(production),
        "inventoried_python_source_count": len(sources),
        "source_and_document_sha256": before,
        "latency_source_sha256": {name: before[name] for name in LATENCY},
        "project_config_sha256": before["pyproject.toml"],
        "notice_sha256": before["NOTICE"],
        "license_sha256": before["LICENSE"],
        "verification_script_sha256": sha(script),
        "verification_script_checks": script_checks,
        "independent_source_protocol_review": tooling_audit,
        "result_evidence_sha256": inventory(evidence_paths()),
        "study_source_declaration": {
            "path": str(DECLARATION.relative_to(ROOT)),
            "sha256": digest(DECLARATION),
            "declared_sha256": declaration,
            "four_python_sources_match": True,
            "current_latency_doc_sha256": before["docs/analysis/latency.md"],
            "documentation_scope": (
                "Declaration pins prospective study documentation. Final docs may "
                "append terminal observations, captured separately in this package."
            ),
        },
        "cuda_b1_auditor_relocation": (
            None
            if not RELOCATION.exists()
            else {
                "path": str(RELOCATION.relative_to(ROOT)),
                "sha256": digest(RELOCATION),
                "mapping": json.loads(RELOCATION.read_bytes()),
                "mapped_archive_bytes_and_review_hash_verified": True,
            }
        ),
        "verification_script_archive": {
            "path": str(archive_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
            "sha256": archive_hash,
        },
        "previous_receipts_and_dist_sha256": preserved,
        "isolated_checks": checks,
        "all_production_bytes_match": True,
        "sdist_current_sources_and_docs_match": True,
        "typed_marker_and_notice_license_match": True,
        "wheel_and_sdist_no_weights_raw_capture_raw_xml_tensors_venv": True,
        "admitted_sanitized_xml_members": [
            name for name in members if name.endswith(".xml")
        ],
        "historical_receipts_and_dist_preserved": True,
        "source_stable_across_build_and_verification": True,
        "limitations": [
            (
                "Packaging integrity and dependency-free entrypoints only; "
                "no inference/device/quality/performance check."
            ),
            (
                "The Python inventory includes historical/archive source; "
                "its count is not a maintained-scope validation claim."
            ),
            (
                "Sources reflect only the exact inventoried build snapshot; "
                "later source changes require separate verification."
            ),
            (
                "This receipt and source archive were created after this build "
                "and cannot be included in their own sdist."
            ),
        ],
    }
    with RECEIPT.open("x") as output:
        output.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "receipt": str(RECEIPT),
                "wheel_sha256": digest(wheel),
                "sdist_sha256": digest(sdist),
                "source_count": len(sources),
                "sdist_members": len(members),
            }
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal

from benchmarks.analysis.torch.process import launch


class Arguments(argparse.Namespace):
    model: Path
    output: Path
    manifest: Path
    manifest_sha256: str
    sources: Path
    sources_sha256: str
    control: Path
    control_sha256: str
    mode: Literal["confirm", "timing"]
    batch_size: int
    confirmation: Path | None
    confirmation_sha256: str | None
    confirmation_wall_sha256: str | None
    worker: bool


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("model", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    for field in ("manifest", "sources", "control"):
        parser.add_argument(f"--{field}", type=Path, required=True)
        parser.add_argument(f"--{field}-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=("confirm", "timing"), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, choices=(1, 8), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--confirmation", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--confirmation-sha256")
    parser.add_argument("--confirmation-wall-sha256")
    parser.add_argument("--worker", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(namespace=Arguments())
    if args.worker:
        from .study import study

        return (
            0
            if study(
                args.model,
                args.output,
                manifest=args.manifest,
                manifest_sha256=args.manifest_sha256,
                sources=args.sources,
                sources_sha256=args.sources_sha256,
                control=args.control,
                control_sha256=args.control_sha256,
                mode=args.mode,
                batch_size=args.batch_size,
                confirmation=args.confirmation,
                confirmation_sha256=args.confirmation_sha256,
                confirmation_wall_sha256=args.confirmation_wall_sha256,
            )
            else 1
        )
    if any(
        path.exists()
        for path in (
            args.output,
            args.output.with_suffix(".wall.json"),
            args.output.with_suffix(".log"),
        )
    ):
        raise ValueError("A new trial must not overwrite an existing receipt/wall/log")
    options = [
        "--mode",
        args.mode,
        "--batch-size",
        str(args.batch_size),
        "--manifest",
        str(args.manifest),
        "--manifest-sha256",
        args.manifest_sha256,
        "--sources",
        str(args.sources),
        "--sources-sha256",
        args.sources_sha256,
        "--control",
        str(args.control),
        "--control-sha256",
        args.control_sha256,
    ]
    if args.confirmation is not None:
        options.extend(("--confirmation", str(args.confirmation)))
    if args.confirmation_sha256 is not None:
        options.extend(("--confirmation-sha256", args.confirmation_sha256))
    if args.confirmation_wall_sha256 is not None:
        options.extend(("--confirmation-wall-sha256", args.confirmation_wall_sha256))
    return launch(
        "benchmarks.analysis.cuda.latency.run",
        args.model,
        args.output,
        timeout=180,
        worker_args=tuple(options),
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

def admit_sources(path: Path, sha256: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    if digest(path) != sha256:
        raise ValueError("Latency source declaration changed")
    saved = cast(dict[str, str], read_object(path))
    if set(saved) != {str(item) for item in SOURCES} or any(
        digest(ROOT / name) != value for name, value in saved.items()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Every exact latency source is required unchanged")
    return saved


def read_cycle(value: object, cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...]) -> BenchmarkCycle:
    saved = cast(dict[str, object], value)
    raw = cast(list[dict[str, object]], saved["rows"])
    if len(raw) != len(cases):
        raise ValueError("History cycle must cover its entire canonical cohort")
    rows: list[EvaluationRow] = []
    for item, case in zip(raw, cases, strict=True):
        prediction = cast(dict[str, object], item["prediction"])
        decision = decision_from_logits(
            case.request, cast(list[float], prediction["scores"]), MODEL_ID
        )
        correct = decision.selected in case.expected
        if (
            item["id"] != case.id
            or item["expected"] != list(case.expected)
            or item["status"] != "ok"
            or item["error"] is not None
            or prediction != decision.to_dict()
            or item["correct"] != correct
        ):
            raise ValueError("History output is failed, reordered or inconsistent")
        rows.append(
            EvaluationRow(
                case.id,
                case.expected,
                "ok",
                decision,
                correct,
                float(cast(float, item["latency_ms"])),
                None,
            )
        )
    return BenchmarkCycle(
        float(cast(float, saved["latency_ms"])),
        tuple(rows),
        int(cast(int, saved["peak_rss_before_bytes"])),
        int(cast(int, saved["peak_rss_after_bytes"])),
    )


def require_parent(path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    wall = read_object(path.with_suffix(".wall.json"))
    if (
        wall.get("exit_code") != 0
        or wall.get("completed") is not True
        or wall.get("timed_out") is not False
        or wall.get("timeout_seconds") != 180
    ):
        raise ValueError("History parent failed terminal cleanup or its owned cap")
    return cast(dict[str, object], wall)


def admit_screens(
    reference: BenchmarkCycle, cuda: BenchmarkCycle, cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...]
) -> dict[str, str]:
    pins = {str(ATTENTION_DECLARATION): ATTENTION_SHA}
    admit_attention(ROOT / ATTENTION_DECLARATION, ATTENTION_SHA)
    for batch, (main_sha, wall_sha) in SCREEN_PINS.items():
        path = (
            ROOT / f"benchmarks/analysis/results/cuda-attention-observer-b{batch}.json"
        )
        archive = path.with_suffix(".sources-686a18493cecf093.json")
        for item, expected in (
            (path, main_sha),
            (path.with_suffix(".wall.json"), wall_sha),
            (archive, ARCHIVE_SHA),
        ):
            if digest(item) != expected:
                raise ValueError("Reviewed attention screen history changed")
            pins[str(item.relative_to(ROOT))] = expected
        saved = read_object(path)
        require_parent(path)
        current = source_paths()
        if any(
            name not in current or digest(current[name]) != sha
            for name, sha in cast(dict[str, str], saved["source_sha256"]).items()
        ):
            raise ValueError("Consumed screen sources, including external HF, changed")
        if (
            saved.get("completed") is not True
            or saved.get("quality_passed") is not True
            or saved.get("dispatch_passed") is not True
            or saved.get("accepted") is not False
            or saved.get("batch_size") != batch
            or saved.get("source_declaration_sha256") != ATTENTION_SHA
            or saved.get("case_ids") != [case.id for case in cases[:8]]
            or any(cast(dict[str, list[str]], saved["unknown_case_ids"]).values())
        ):
            raise ValueError("Reviewed attention screen is incomplete")
        for arm in ("math", "efficient"):
            for phase, cohort in (
                ("cycle", cases[:8]),
                ("profile_cycle", cases[:batch]),
            ):
                cycle = read_cycle(saved[f"{arm}_{phase}"], cohort)
                passed, _ = check_cycle(
                    cycle,
                    replace(reference, rows=reference.rows[: len(cohort)]),
                    replace(cuda, rows=cuda.rows[: len(cohort)]),
                )
                if not passed:
                    raise ValueError("Reviewed screen fails unchanged CPU/CUDA gates")
        if not efficient_dispatch_gate(
            cast(dict[str, object], saved["efficient_profile"]),
            batch_size=batch,
            length=172 if batch == 1 else 192,
        ):
            raise ValueError("Reviewed representative screen dispatch is unsupported")
    return pins


def admit_confirmation(
    path: Path | None,
    sha256: str | None,
    *,
    wall_sha256: str | None,
    batch_size: int,
    source_hashes: dict[str, str],
    reference: BenchmarkCycle,
    cuda: BenchmarkCycle,
    cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...],
) -> dict[str, str]:
    if (
        path is None
        or sha256 is None
        or wall_sha256 is None
        or digest(path) != sha256
        or digest(path.with_suffix(".wall.json")) != wall_sha256
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Timing requires an independently reviewed confirmation identity"
        )
    saved = read_object(path)
    require_parent(path)
    if (
        saved.get("mode") != "confirm"
        or saved.get("batch_size") != batch_size
        or saved.get("completed") is not True
        or saved.get("quality_passed") is not True
        or saved.get("dispatch_passed") is not True
        or saved.get("accepted") is not False
        or saved.get("case_ids") != [case.id for case in cases]
        or saved.get("input_sha256") != INPUT_SHA
        or cast(dict[str, str], saved["new_source_hashes"]) != source_hashes
        or any(cast(dict[str, list[str]], saved["unknown_case_ids"]).values())
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Confirmation is incomplete or differs from the timing contract"
        )
    current = source_paths()
    hashes = cast(dict[str, str], saved["source_sha256"])
    if set(hashes) != set(current) or any(
        digest(current[name]) != sha for name, sha in hashes.items()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Confirmation source identity differs from current execution")
    archive = cast(dict[str, str], saved["source_archive"])
    archive_path = path.with_suffix(f".sources-{archive['sha256'][:16]}.json")
    if digest(archive_path) != archive["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Confirmation source archive changed")
    cycles = cast(list[dict[str, object]], saved["cycles"])
    if [item.get("key") for item in cycles] != ["confirm_math", "confirm_efficient"]:
        raise ValueError("Confirmation must contain both complete ordinary arms")
    paired: list[BenchmarkCycle] = []
    for item in cycles:
        cycle = read_cycle(item["cycle"], cases)
        if not check_cycle(cycle, reference, cuda)[0]:
            raise ValueError("Confirmation fails unchanged CPU/CUDA numerical gates")
        paired.append(cycle)
    if not compare_cycles((paired[0],), (paired[1],), QualityGate()).passed:
        raise ValueError("Confirmation arms fail paired quality")
    profiled = cases[:batch_size]
    for arm in ("math", "efficient"):
        cycle = read_cycle(saved[f"{arm}_profile_cycle"], profiled)
        if not check_cycle(
            cycle,
            replace(reference, rows=reference.rows[:batch_size]),
            replace(cuda, rows=cuda.rows[:batch_size]),
        )[0]:
            raise ValueError("Confirmation profile output fails unchanged quality")
    if not efficient_dispatch_gate(
        cast(dict[str, object], saved["efficient_profile"]),
        batch_size=batch_size,
        length=172 if batch_size == 1 else 192,
    ):
        raise ValueError("Confirmation profile is not the reviewed efficient dispatch")
    return {
        str(path): sha256,
        str(path.with_suffix(".wall.json")): wall_sha256,
        str(archive_path): archive["sha256"],
    }


def cycle_data(cycle: BenchmarkCycle) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Keep unsupported timing evidence JSON-safe without losing returned rows."""
    saved = cycle.to_dict()
    invalid: dict[str, str] = {}
    if not math.isfinite(cycle.latency_ms):
        invalid["latency_ms"] = repr(cycle.latency_ms)
        saved["latency_ms"] = None
    for row in cast(list[dict[str, object]], saved["rows"]):
        value = cast(float, row["latency_ms"])
        if not math.isfinite(value):
            invalid[f"row:{row['id']}"] = repr(value)
            row["latency_ms"] = None
    if invalid:
        saved["invalid_timing"] = invalid
    return saved


def collect(
    engine: BenchmarkEngine,
    cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...],
    reference: BenchmarkCycle,
    cuda: BenchmarkCycle,
    *,
    key: str,
    payload: dict[str, object],
    write: Callable[[], None],
    verify: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
) -> BenchmarkCycle:
    """Ownership and persistence surround, never enter, canonical batch timers."""
    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
    chunks: list[BenchmarkCycle] = []
    observations: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    record: dict[str, object] = {
        "key": key,
        "chunks": [],
        "ownership": observations,
        "drift": [],
    }
    cast(list[dict[str, object]], payload["cycles"]).append(record)
    unknown = cast(dict[str, list[str]], payload["unknown_case_ids"])
    for offset in range(0, len(cases), engine.batch_size):
        if verify is not None:
            verify()
        observations.append(
            {
                "utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
                "offset": offset,
                "snapshot": occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid()),
            }
        )
        cohort = cases[offset : offset + engine.batch_size]
        chunk = _run(engine, cohort)
        chunks.append(chunk)
        cast(list[dict[str, object]], record["chunks"]).append(cycle_data(chunk))
        unknown[key] = [
            case.id
            for case in cases
            if case.id not in {row.id for item in chunks for row in item.rows}
        ]
        try:
            passed, drift = check_cycle(
                chunk,
                replace(reference, rows=reference.rows[offset : offset + len(cohort)]),
                replace(cuda, rows=cuda.rows[offset : offset + len(cohort)]),
            )
            cast(list[dict[str, object]], record["drift"]).append(drift)
        finally:
            # One retained update per returned batch, also on gate exceptions.
            write()
        if chunk.failed or not passed:
            raise ValueError(f"{key} batch failed unchanged quality gates")
        if (
            not math.isfinite(chunk.latency_ms)
            or chunk.latency_ms <= 0
            or any(
                not math.isfinite(row.latency_ms) or row.latency_ms < 0
                for row in chunk.rows
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError("Canonical batch interval must be finite and positive")
    cycle = BenchmarkCycle(
        math.fsum(item.latency_ms for item in chunks),
        tuple(row for item in chunks for row in item.rows),
        chunks[0].peak_rss_before_bytes,
        chunks[-1].peak_rss_after_bytes,
    )
    record.update(
        cycle=cycle.to_dict(), cohort_wall_ms=(time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
    )
    write()
    return cycle


def performance(
    baseline: tuple[BenchmarkCycle, ...], candidate: tuple[BenchmarkCycle, ...]
) -> dict[str, object]:
    if len(baseline) != 6 or len(candidate) != 6:
        raise ValueError("Six complete paired cohorts are required")
    left, right = (
        [item.latency_ms for item in baseline],
        [item.latency_ms for item in candidate],
    )
    if any(not math.isfinite(value) or value <= 0 for value in (*left, *right)):
        raise ValueError("Paired intervals must be finite and positive")
    ratios = [a / b for a, b in zip(left, right, strict=True)]
    median, low = percentile(ratios, 0.5), percentile(ratios, 0.05)
    aggregate = math.fsum(left) / math.fsum(right)
    tail = percentile(right, 0.95) / percentile(left, 0.95)
    return {
        "paired_ratios": ratios,
        "median": median,
        "p05": low,
        "aggregate": aggregate,
        "cohort_p95_ratio": tail,
        "passed": median >= 1.05 and low > 1 and aggregate > 1 and tail <= 1,
    }


def study(
    model: Path,
    output: Path,
    *,
    manifest: Path,
    manifest_sha256: str,
    sources: Path,
    sources_sha256: str,
    control: Path,
    control_sha256: str,
    mode: Mode,
    batch_size: int,
    confirmation: Path | None = None,
    confirmation_sha256: str | None = None,
    confirmation_wall_sha256: str | None = None,
) -> bool:
    if (
        mode not in ("confirm", "timing")
        or type(batch_size) is not int
        or batch_size not in (1, 8)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Use a declared confirmation/timing mode and batch1/8")
    if mode == "confirm" and (
        confirmation is not None
        or confirmation_sha256 is not None
        or confirmation_wall_sha256 is not None
    ):
        raise ValueError("Confirmation must not consume another confirmation")
    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
    payload: dict[str, object] = {
        "mode": mode,
        "batch_size": batch_size,
        "completed": False,
        "quality_passed": False,
        "dispatch_passed": False,
        "dispatch_evidence_scope": (
            "prior representative confirmation profile; timed calls unprofiled"
            if mode == "timing"
            else (
                "current representative first-batch profile; "
                "ordinary cohorts unprofiled"
            )
        ),
        "performance_passed": False,
        "accepted": False,
        "cycles": [],
        "scope": "Pinned77 BANKING77 training-source menus; exposure unknown",
        "gate": asdict(QualityGate()),
        "input_sha256": INPUT_SHA,
        "timing_scope": (
            "Sum synchronized _run(batch).latency_ms including row bookkeeping; "
            "telemetry-paced; excludes ownership/I/O/quality/gaps"
        ),
        "limitations": [
            "No online capacity/tail or universal speed claim",
            "Instantaneous ownership is not a reservation",
            "Unstarted outcomes unknown; profiler is diagnostic only",
            "FP32 tensors do not imply IEEE efficient-attention arithmetic",
        ],
    }

    def write() -> None:
        output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, allow_nan=False) + "\n")

    # The worker owns this new receipt; never replace another trial's history.
    with output.open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(payload, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    try:
        if manifest_sha256 != MANIFEST_SHA or digest(manifest) != MANIFEST_SHA:
            raise ValueError(
                "Only the original immutable 44-asset manifest is admitted"
            )
        admission = admit(manifest)
        new_hashes = admit_sources(sources, sources_sha256)
        admit_attention(ROOT / ATTENTION_DECLARATION, ATTENTION_SHA)
        if (
            control_sha256 != CONTROL_SHA
            or digest(control.with_suffix(".wall.json")) != CONTROL_WALL_SHA
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Only the reviewed original CUDA control/main wall is admitted"
            )
        pinned = admit_control(
            control, control_sha256, admission, batch_size=batch_size
        )
        payload.update(
            admission=admission,
            control=pinned,
            new_source_hashes=new_hashes,
            source_declaration_sha256=sources_sha256,
        )
        if any(
            (
                sdpa_attention._is_torch_mps_available,
                sdpa_attention._is_torch_xpu_available,
                sdpa_attention._is_torch_npu_available,
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "This experiment requires frozen Linux CUDA HF availability"
            )
        frozen = freeze_sources(source_paths(), output)
        payload.update(source_sha256=frozen.hashes(), source_archive=frozen.archive())
        artifact = load_artifact(model, 512)
        if artifact.model_id != MODEL_ID:
            raise ValueError("Checkpoint identity differs from the frozen reference")
        cases = tuple(
            case_from_dict(decode_json(line))
            for line in (ROOT / DATA).read_text().splitlines()
        )
        if len(cases) != 77 or _input_digest(cases) != INPUT_SHA:
            raise ValueError("Every exact canonical case must remain ordered")
        payload.update(
            case_ids=[case.id for case in cases],
            expected_ordinary_rows=154 if mode == "confirm" else 1078,
            expected_profile_rows=2 * batch_size if mode == "confirm" else 0,
        )
        schedule = (
            [("confirm", None, ("math", "efficient"))]
            if mode == "confirm"
            else [("warmup", None, ("math", "efficient"))]
            + [
                (
                    "pair",
                    repeat,
                    ("math", "efficient") if repeat % 2 == 0 else ("efficient", "math"),
                )
                for repeat in range(6)
            ]
        )
        keys = [
            f"{phase}{'' if repeat is None else repeat}_{arm}"
            for phase, repeat, order in schedule
            for arm in order
        ]
        payload["unknown_case_ids"] = {key: [case.id for case in cases] for key in keys}
        if mode == "confirm":
            cast(dict[str, list[str]], payload["unknown_case_ids"]).update(
                {
                    f"{arm}_profile": [case.id for case in cases[:batch_size]]
                    for arm in ("math", "efficient")
                }
            )
        write()
        inputs = ReferenceInput(
            artifact.model_id,
            KaiEncoder.from_artifact(artifact, max_length=512, token_cache_size=0),
        )
        reference = read_reference(
            ROOT / REFERENCE, cases, inputs, dataset_sha256=DATA_SHA
        )
        cuda = control_cycle(control, cases)
        if not compare_cycles((reference,), (cuda,), QualityGate()).passed:
            raise ValueError("Reviewed CUDA control fails the original CPU reference")
        history = admit_screens(reference, cuda, cases)
        if mode == "timing":
            confirmed = admit_confirmation(
                confirmation,
                confirmation_sha256,
                wall_sha256=confirmation_wall_sha256,
                batch_size=batch_size,
                source_hashes=new_hashes,
                reference=reference,
                cuda=cuda,
                cases=cases,
            )
            history.update(confirmed)
            payload.update(confirmation=confirmed, dispatch_passed=True)
        payload["history_sha256"] = history

        def verify() -> None:
            if any(digest(Path(item.path)) != item.sha256 for item in frozen.files):
                raise ValueError("Consumed source changed between inference batches")

        payload["occupancy_before_load"] = occupancy()
        write()
        torch.set_num_threads(8)
        base = KaiScorer.from_directory(
            model, device="cpu", max_length=512, token_cache_size=0
        )
        read_reference(ROOT / REFERENCE, cases, base, dataset_sha256=DATA_SHA)
        payload["occupancy_before_allocation"] = occupancy()
        with ieee_precision():
            base.device = torch.device("cuda:0")
            cast(nn.Module, base.backbone).to(base.device)
            base.head.to(base.device)
            require_fp32(base)
            scorers: dict[str, Scorer] = {
                "math": FP32Scorer(base),
                "efficient": efficient_scorer(base),
            }
            engines = {
                arm: BenchmarkEngine(
                    arm,
                    Model(scorer, model_id=MODEL_ID),
                    batch_size=batch_size,
                    synchronize=torch.cuda.synchronize,
                )
                for arm, scorer in scorers.items()
            }
            measured: dict[str, list[BenchmarkCycle]] = {"math": [], "efficient": []}
            warm: dict[str, list[BenchmarkCycle]] = {"math": [], "efficient": []}
            for phase, repeat, order in schedule:
                current: dict[str, BenchmarkCycle] = {}
                for arm in order:
                    key = f"{phase}{'' if repeat is None else repeat}_{arm}"
                    payload["phase"] = key
                    write()
                    current[arm] = collect(
                        engines[arm],
                        cases,
                        reference,
                        cuda,
                        key=key,
                        payload=payload,
                        write=write,
                        verify=verify,
                    )
                    if phase == "warmup":
                        warm[arm].append(current[arm])
                    elif phase == "pair":
                        measured[arm].append(current[arm])
                drift = compare_cycles(
                    (current["math"],), (current["efficient"],), QualityGate()
                )
                payload[f"{phase}{'' if repeat is None else repeat}_paired_drift"] = (
                    asdict(drift)
                )
                write()
                if not drift.passed:
                    raise ValueError("Paired arms fail unchanged quality gates")
            if mode == "confirm":
                profiled = cases[:batch_size]
                for arm in ("math", "efficient"):
                    payload["phase"] = f"{arm}_profile"
                    occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid())
                    write()
                    cycle, observed = profile_batch(scorers[arm], profiled, name=arm)
                    payload[f"{arm}_profile_cycle"] = cycle_data(cycle)
                    payload[f"{arm}_profile"] = observed
                    cast(dict[str, list[str]], payload["unknown_case_ids"])[
                        f"{arm}_profile"
                    ] = [
                        case.id
                        for case in profiled
                        if case.id not in {row.id for row in cycle.rows}
                    ]
                    passed, profile_drift = check_cycle(
                        cycle,
                        replace(reference, rows=reference.rows[:batch_size]),
                        replace(cuda, rows=cuda.rows[:batch_size]),
                    )
                    payload[f"{arm}_profile_drift"] = profile_drift
                    write()
                    if not passed:
                        raise ValueError("Representative profile quality failed")
                payload["dispatch_passed"] = efficient_dispatch_gate(
                    cast(dict[str, object], payload["efficient_profile"]),
                    batch_size=batch_size,
                    length=max(
                        len(base.encode_request(case.request).ids) for case in profiled
                    ),
                )
                if payload["dispatch_passed"] is not True:
                    raise ValueError("Representative efficient dispatch is unsupported")
            else:
                left, right = tuple(measured["math"]), tuple(measured["efficient"])
                report = BenchmarkReport(
                    INPUT_SHA,
                    cases,
                    BenchmarkProtocol(repeats=6, warmup=1),
                    engines["math"],
                    engines["efficient"],
                    left,
                    right,
                    compare_cycles(left, right, QualityGate()),
                    tuple(warm["math"]),
                    tuple(warm["efficient"]),
                ).to_dict()
                cast(dict[str, object], report["protocol"])["timing"] = payload[
                    "timing_scope"
                ]
                payload.update(report=report, performance=performance(left, right))
                payload["performance_passed"] = cast(
                    dict[str, object], payload["performance"]
                )["passed"]
            payload["occupancy_after"] = occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid())
            payload["cuda_memory"] = {
                "peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
                "peak_reserved_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(),
            }
        admit_attention(ROOT / ATTENTION_DECLARATION, ATTENTION_SHA)

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

    if args.worker:

            0

                args.model,
                args.output,
                manifest=args.manifest,
                manifest_sha256=args.manifest_sha256,
                sources=args.sources,
                sources_sha256=args.sources_sha256,

                confirmation=args.confirmation,
                confirmation_sha256=args.confirmation_sha256,
                confirmation_wall_sha256=args.confirmation_wall_sha256,
            )
            else 1
        )
    if any(
        path.exists()
        for path in (
            args.output,
            args.output.with_suffix(".wall.json"),
            args.output.with_suffix(".log"),
        )
    ):
        raise ValueError("A new trial must not overwrite an existing receipt/wall/log")
    options = [
        "--mode",
        args.mode,
        "--batch-size",
        str(args.batch_size),
        "--manifest",
        str(args.manifest),
        "--manifest-sha256",
        args.manifest_sha256,
        "--sources",
        str(args.sources),
        "--sources-sha256",
        args.sources_sha256,
        "--control",
        str(args.control),
        "--control-sha256",
        args.control_sha256,
    ]
    if args.confirmation is not None:
        options.extend(("--confirmation", str(args.confirmation)))
    if args.confirmation_sha256 is not None:
        options.extend(("--confirmation-sha256", args.confirmation_sha256))
    if args.confirmation_wall_sha256 is not None:
        options.extend(("--confirmation-wall-sha256", args.confirmation_wall_sha256))
    return launch(
        "benchmarks.analysis.cuda.latency.run",
        args.model,
        args.output,
        timeout=180,
        worker_args=tuple(options),
    )

MANIFEST_SHA = "f7d9d7a4755a8df37e7e55d577489a1f9597760a68928b2a8213a0d19d3c6866"
ATTENTION_DECLARATION = Path(

SCREEN_PINS = {

    ),

CONTROL_WALL_SHA = "cb00f5f065a04e5c598da04cb3e57a7b75bbaedeb1407dc6ebbb0dd806f4dc8e"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ReferenceInput:
    """Validate the exact tokenizer contract before loading checkpoint tensors."""

    model_id: str
    encoder: KaiEncoder

    def encode_request(self, request: Request) -> EncodedRequest:
        return self.encoder.encode_request(request)


def source_paths() -> dict[str, Path]:
    paths = {
        str(path): ROOT / path
        for path in (*asset_paths(), *ATTENTION_SOURCES, *SOURCES)
        if path.suffix in (".py", ".md")
    }
    paths.update(
        external_qwen3=Path(modeling_qwen3.__file__),
        external_sdpa=Path(sdpa_attention.__file__),
        external_masking=Path(masking_utils.__file__),
    )
    return paths


def admit_sources(path: Path, sha256: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    if digest(path) != sha256:
        raise ValueError("Latency source declaration changed")
    saved = cast(dict[str, str], read_object(path))
    if set(saved) != {str(item) for item in SOURCES} or any(
        digest(ROOT / name) != value for name, value in saved.items()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Every exact latency source is required unchanged")
    return saved


def read_cycle(value: object, cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...]) -> BenchmarkCycle:
    saved = cast(dict[str, object], value)
    raw = cast(list[dict[str, object]], saved["rows"])
    if len(raw) != len(cases):
        raise ValueError("History cycle must cover its entire canonical cohort")
    rows: list[EvaluationRow] = []
    for item, case in zip(raw, cases, strict=True):
        prediction = cast(dict[str, object], item["prediction"])
        decision = decision_from_logits(
            case.request, cast(list[float], prediction["scores"]), MODEL_ID
        )
        correct = decision.selected in case.expected
        if (
            item["id"] != case.id
            or item["expected"] != list(case.expected)
            or item["status"] != "ok"
            or item["error"] is not None
            or prediction != decision.to_dict()
            or item["correct"] != correct
        ):
            raise ValueError("History output is failed, reordered or inconsistent")
        rows.append(
            EvaluationRow(
                case.id,
                case.expected,
                "ok",
                decision,
                correct,
                float(cast(float, item["latency_ms"])),
                None,
            )
        )
    return BenchmarkCycle(
        float(cast(float, saved["latency_ms"])),
        tuple(rows),
        int(cast(int, saved["peak_rss_before_bytes"])),
        int(cast(int, saved["peak_rss_after_bytes"])),
    )


def require_parent(path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    wall = read_object(path.with_suffix(".wall.json"))
    if (
        wall.get("exit_code") != 0
        or wall.get("completed") is not True
        or wall.get("timed_out") is not False
        or wall.get("timeout_seconds") != 180
    ):
        raise ValueError("History parent failed terminal cleanup or its owned cap")
    return cast(dict[str, object], wall)


def admit_screens(
    reference: BenchmarkCycle, cuda: BenchmarkCycle, cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...]
) -> dict[str, str]:
    pins = {str(ATTENTION_DECLARATION): ATTENTION_SHA}
    admit_attention(ROOT / ATTENTION_DECLARATION, ATTENTION_SHA)
    for batch, (main_sha, wall_sha) in SCREEN_PINS.items():
        path = (
            ROOT / f"benchmarks/analysis/results/cuda-attention-observer-b{batch}.json"
        )
        archive = path.with_suffix(".sources-686a18493cecf093.json")
        for item, expected in (
            (path, main_sha),
            (path.with_suffix(".wall.json"), wall_sha),
            (archive, ARCHIVE_SHA),
        ):
            if digest(item) != expected:
                raise ValueError("Reviewed attention screen history changed")
            pins[str(item.relative_to(ROOT))] = expected
        saved = read_object(path)
        require_parent(path)
        current = source_paths()
        if any(
            name not in current or digest(current[name]) != sha
            for name, sha in cast(dict[str, str], saved["source_sha256"]).items()
        ):
            raise ValueError("Consumed screen sources, including external HF, changed")
        if (
            saved.get("completed") is not True
            or saved.get("quality_passed") is not True
            or saved.get("dispatch_passed") is not True
            or saved.get("accepted") is not False
            or saved.get("batch_size") != batch
            or saved.get("source_declaration_sha256") != ATTENTION_SHA
            or saved.get("case_ids") != [case.id for case in cases[:8]]
            or any(cast(dict[str, list[str]], saved["unknown_case_ids"]).values())
        ):
            raise ValueError("Reviewed attention screen is incomplete")
        for arm in ("math", "efficient"):
            for phase, cohort in (
                ("cycle", cases[:8]),
                ("profile_cycle", cases[:batch]),
            ):
                cycle = read_cycle(saved[f"{arm}_{phase}"], cohort)
                passed, _ = check_cycle(
                    cycle,
                    replace(reference, rows=reference.rows[: len(cohort)]),
                    replace(cuda, rows=cuda.rows[: len(cohort)]),
                )
                if not passed:
                    raise ValueError("Reviewed screen fails unchanged CPU/CUDA gates")
        if not efficient_dispatch_gate(
            cast(dict[str, object], saved["efficient_profile"]),
            batch_size=batch,
            length=172 if batch == 1 else 192,
        ):
            raise ValueError("Reviewed representative screen dispatch is unsupported")
    return pins


def admit_confirmation(
    path: Path | None,
    sha256: str | None,
    *,
    wall_sha256: str | None,
    batch_size: int,
    source_hashes: dict[str, str],
    reference: BenchmarkCycle,
    cuda: BenchmarkCycle,
    cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...],
) -> dict[str, str]:
    if (
        path is None
        or sha256 is None
        or wall_sha256 is None
        or digest(path) != sha256
        or digest(path.with_suffix(".wall.json")) != wall_sha256
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Timing requires an independently reviewed confirmation identity"
        )
    saved = read_object(path)
    require_parent(path)
    if (
        saved.get("mode") != "confirm"
        or saved.get("batch_size") != batch_size
        or saved.get("completed") is not True
        or saved.get("quality_passed") is not True
        or saved.get("dispatch_passed") is not True
        or saved.get("accepted") is not False
        or saved.get("case_ids") != [case.id for case in cases]
        or saved.get("input_sha256") != INPUT_SHA
        or cast(dict[str, str], saved["new_source_hashes"]) != source_hashes
        or any(cast(dict[str, list[str]], saved["unknown_case_ids"]).values())
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Confirmation is incomplete or differs from the timing contract"
        )
    current = source_paths()
    hashes = cast(dict[str, str], saved["source_sha256"])
    if set(hashes) != set(current) or any(
        digest(current[name]) != sha for name, sha in hashes.items()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Confirmation source identity differs from current execution")
    archive = cast(dict[str, str], saved["source_archive"])
    archive_path = path.with_suffix(f".sources-{archive['sha256'][:16]}.json")
    if digest(archive_path) != archive["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Confirmation source archive changed")
    cycles = cast(list[dict[str, object]], saved["cycles"])
    if [item.get("key") for item in cycles] != ["confirm_math", "confirm_efficient"]:
        raise ValueError("Confirmation must contain both complete ordinary arms")
    paired: list[BenchmarkCycle] = []
    for item in cycles:
        cycle = read_cycle(item["cycle"], cases)
        if not check_cycle(cycle, reference, cuda)[0]:
            raise ValueError("Confirmation fails unchanged CPU/CUDA numerical gates")
        paired.append(cycle)
    if not compare_cycles((paired[0],), (paired[1],), QualityGate()).passed:
        raise ValueError("Confirmation arms fail paired quality")
    profiled = cases[:batch_size]
    for arm in ("math", "efficient"):
        cycle = read_cycle(saved[f"{arm}_profile_cycle"], profiled)
        if not check_cycle(
            cycle,
            replace(reference, rows=reference.rows[:batch_size]),
            replace(cuda, rows=cuda.rows[:batch_size]),
        )[0]:
            raise ValueError("Confirmation profile output fails unchanged quality")
    if not efficient_dispatch_gate(
        cast(dict[str, object], saved["efficient_profile"]),
        batch_size=batch_size,
        length=172 if batch_size == 1 else 192,
    ):
        raise ValueError("Confirmation profile is not the reviewed efficient dispatch")
    return {
        str(path): sha256,
        str(path.with_suffix(".wall.json")): wall_sha256,
        str(archive_path): archive["sha256"],
    }


def cycle_data(cycle: BenchmarkCycle) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Keep unsupported timing evidence JSON-safe without losing returned rows."""
    saved = cycle.to_dict()
    invalid: dict[str, str] = {}
    if not math.isfinite(cycle.latency_ms):
        invalid["latency_ms"] = repr(cycle.latency_ms)
        saved["latency_ms"] = None
    for row in cast(list[dict[str, object]], saved["rows"]):
        value = cast(float, row["latency_ms"])
        if not math.isfinite(value):
            invalid[f"row:{row['id']}"] = repr(value)
            row["latency_ms"] = None
    if invalid:
        saved["invalid_timing"] = invalid
    return saved


def collect(
    engine: BenchmarkEngine,
    cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...],
    reference: BenchmarkCycle,
    cuda: BenchmarkCycle,
    *,
    key: str,
    payload: dict[str, object],
    write: Callable[[], None],
    verify: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
) -> BenchmarkCycle:
    """Ownership and persistence surround, never enter, canonical batch timers."""
    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
    chunks: list[BenchmarkCycle] = []
    observations: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    record: dict[str, object] = {
        "key": key,
        "chunks": [],
        "ownership": observations,
        "drift": [],
    }
    cast(list[dict[str, object]], payload["cycles"]).append(record)
    unknown = cast(dict[str, list[str]], payload["unknown_case_ids"])
    for offset in range(0, len(cases), engine.batch_size):
        if verify is not None:
            verify()
        observations.append(
            {
                "utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
                "offset": offset,
                "snapshot": occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid()),
            }
        )
        cohort = cases[offset : offset + engine.batch_size]
        chunk = _run(engine, cohort)
        chunks.append(chunk)
        cast(list[dict[str, object]], record["chunks"]).append(cycle_data(chunk))
        unknown[key] = [
            case.id
            for case in cases
            if case.id not in {row.id for item in chunks for row in item.rows}
        ]
        try:
            passed, drift = check_cycle(
                chunk,
                replace(reference, rows=reference.rows[offset : offset + len(cohort)]),
                replace(cuda, rows=cuda.rows[offset : offset + len(cohort)]),
            )
            cast(list[dict[str, object]], record["drift"]).append(drift)
        finally:
            # One retained update per returned batch, also on gate exceptions.
            write()
        if chunk.failed or not passed:
            raise ValueError(f"{key} batch failed unchanged quality gates")
        if (
            not math.isfinite(chunk.latency_ms)
            or chunk.latency_ms <= 0
            or any(
                not math.isfinite(row.latency_ms) or row.latency_ms < 0
                for row in chunk.rows
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError("Canonical batch interval must be finite and positive")
    cycle = BenchmarkCycle(
        math.fsum(item.latency_ms for item in chunks),
        tuple(row for item in chunks for row in item.rows),
        chunks[0].peak_rss_before_bytes,
        chunks[-1].peak_rss_after_bytes,
    )
    record.update(
        cycle=cycle.to_dict(), cohort_wall_ms=(time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
    )
    write()
    return cycle


def performance(
    baseline: tuple[BenchmarkCycle, ...], candidate: tuple[BenchmarkCycle, ...]
) -> dict[str, object]:
    if len(baseline) != 6 or len(candidate) != 6:
        raise ValueError("Six complete paired cohorts are required")
    left, right = (
        [item.latency_ms for item in baseline],
        [item.latency_ms for item in candidate],
    )
    if any(not math.isfinite(value) or value <= 0 for value in (*left, *right)):
        raise ValueError("Paired intervals must be finite and positive")
    ratios = [a / b for a, b in zip(left, right, strict=True)]
    median, low = percentile(ratios, 0.5), percentile(ratios, 0.05)
    aggregate = math.fsum(left) / math.fsum(right)
    tail = percentile(right, 0.95) / percentile(left, 0.95)
    return {
        "paired_ratios": ratios,
        "median": median,
        "p05": low,
        "aggregate": aggregate,
        "cohort_p95_ratio": tail,
        "passed": median >= 1.05 and low > 1 and aggregate > 1 and tail <= 1,
    }


def study(
    model: Path,
    output: Path,
    *,
    manifest: Path,
    manifest_sha256: str,
    sources: Path,
    sources_sha256: str,
    control: Path,
    control_sha256: str,
    mode: Mode,
    batch_size: int,
    confirmation: Path | None = None,
    confirmation_sha256: str | None = None,
    confirmation_wall_sha256: str | None = None,
) -> bool:
    if (
        mode not in ("confirm", "timing")
        or type(batch_size) is not int
        or batch_size not in (1, 8)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Use a declared confirmation/timing mode and batch1/8")
    if mode == "confirm" and (
        confirmation is not None
        or confirmation_sha256 is not None
        or confirmation_wall_sha256 is not None
    ):
        raise ValueError("Confirmation must not consume another confirmation")
    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
    payload: dict[str, object] = {
        "mode": mode,
        "batch_size": batch_size,
        "completed": False,
        "quality_passed": False,
        "dispatch_passed": False,
        "dispatch_evidence_scope": (
            "prior representative confirmation profile; timed calls unprofiled"
            if mode == "timing"
            else (
                "current representative first-batch profile; "
                "ordinary cohorts unprofiled"
            )
        ),
        "performance_passed": False,
        "accepted": False,
        "cycles": [],
        "scope": "Pinned77 BANKING77 training-source menus; exposure unknown",
        "gate": asdict(QualityGate()),
        "input_sha256": INPUT_SHA,
        "timing_scope": (
            "Sum synchronized _run(batch).latency_ms including row bookkeeping; "
            "telemetry-paced; excludes ownership/I/O/quality/gaps"
        ),
        "limitations": [
            "No online capacity/tail or universal speed claim",
            "Instantaneous ownership is not a reservation",
            "Unstarted outcomes unknown; profiler is diagnostic only",
            "FP32 tensors do not imply IEEE efficient-attention arithmetic",
        ],
    }

    def write() -> None:
        output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, allow_nan=False) + "\n")

    # The worker owns this new receipt; never replace another trial's history.
    with output.open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(payload, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    try:
        if manifest_sha256 != MANIFEST_SHA or digest(manifest) != MANIFEST_SHA:
            raise ValueError(
                "Only the original immutable 44-asset manifest is admitted"
            )
        admission = admit(manifest)
        new_hashes = admit_sources(sources, sources_sha256)
        admit_attention(ROOT / ATTENTION_DECLARATION, ATTENTION_SHA)
        if (
            control_sha256 != CONTROL_SHA
            or digest(control.with_suffix(".wall.json")) != CONTROL_WALL_SHA
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Only the reviewed original CUDA control/main wall is admitted"
            )
        pinned = admit_control(
            control, control_sha256, admission, batch_size=batch_size
        )
        payload.update(
            admission=admission,
            control=pinned,
            new_source_hashes=new_hashes,
            source_declaration_sha256=sources_sha256,
        )
        if any(
            (
                sdpa_attention._is_torch_mps_available,
                sdpa_attention._is_torch_xpu_available,
                sdpa_attention._is_torch_npu_available,
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "This experiment requires frozen Linux CUDA HF availability"
            )
        frozen = freeze_sources(source_paths(), output)
        payload.update(source_sha256=frozen.hashes(), source_archive=frozen.archive())
        artifact = load_artifact(model, 512)
        if artifact.model_id != MODEL_ID:
            raise ValueError("Checkpoint identity differs from the frozen reference")
        cases = tuple(
            case_from_dict(decode_json(line))
            for line in (ROOT / DATA).read_text().splitlines()
        )
        if len(cases) != 77 or _input_digest(cases) != INPUT_SHA:
            raise ValueError("Every exact canonical case must remain ordered")
        payload.update(
            case_ids=[case.id for case in cases],
            expected_ordinary_rows=154 if mode == "confirm" else 1078,
            expected_profile_rows=2 * batch_size if mode == "confirm" else 0,
        )
        schedule = (
            [("confirm", None, ("math", "efficient"))]
            if mode == "confirm"
            else [("warmup", None, ("math", "efficient"))]
            + [
                (
                    "pair",
                    repeat,
                    ("math", "efficient") if repeat % 2 == 0 else ("efficient", "math"),
                )
                for repeat in range(6)
            ]
        )
        keys = [
            f"{phase}{'' if repeat is None else repeat}_{arm}"
            for phase, repeat, order in schedule
            for arm in order
        ]
        payload["unknown_case_ids"] = {key: [case.id for case in cases] for key in keys}
        if mode == "confirm":
            cast(dict[str, list[str]], payload["unknown_case_ids"]).update(
                {
                    f"{arm}_profile": [case.id for case in cases[:batch_size]]
                    for arm in ("math", "efficient")
                }
            )
        write()
        inputs = ReferenceInput(
            artifact.model_id,
            KaiEncoder.from_artifact(artifact, max_length=512, token_cache_size=0),
        )
        reference = read_reference(
            ROOT / REFERENCE, cases, inputs, dataset_sha256=DATA_SHA
        )
        cuda = control_cycle(control, cases)
        if not compare_cycles((reference,), (cuda,), QualityGate()).passed:
            raise ValueError("Reviewed CUDA control fails the original CPU reference")
        history = admit_screens(reference, cuda, cases)
        if mode == "timing":
            confirmed = admit_confirmation(
                confirmation,
                confirmation_sha256,
                wall_sha256=confirmation_wall_sha256,
                batch_size=batch_size,
                source_hashes=new_hashes,
                reference=reference,
                cuda=cuda,
                cases=cases,
            )
            history.update(confirmed)
            payload.update(confirmation=confirmed, dispatch_passed=True)
        payload["history_sha256"] = history

        def verify() -> None:
            if any(digest(Path(item.path)) != item.sha256 for item in frozen.files):
                raise ValueError("Consumed source changed between inference batches")

        payload["occupancy_before_load"] = occupancy()
        write()
        torch.set_num_threads(8)
        base = KaiScorer.from_directory(
            model, device="cpu", max_length=512, token_cache_size=0
        )
        read_reference(ROOT / REFERENCE, cases, base, dataset_sha256=DATA_SHA)
        payload["occupancy_before_allocation"] = occupancy()
        with ieee_precision():
            base.device = torch.device("cuda:0")
            cast(nn.Module, base.backbone).to(base.device)
            base.head.to(base.device)
            require_fp32(base)
            scorers: dict[str, Scorer] = {
                "math": FP32Scorer(base),
                "efficient": efficient_scorer(base),
            }
            engines = {
                arm: BenchmarkEngine(
                    arm,
                    Model(scorer, model_id=MODEL_ID),
                    batch_size=batch_size,
                    synchronize=torch.cuda.synchronize,
                )
                for arm, scorer in scorers.items()
            }
            measured: dict[str, list[BenchmarkCycle]] = {"math": [], "efficient": []}
            warm: dict[str, list[BenchmarkCycle]] = {"math": [], "efficient": []}
            for phase, repeat, order in schedule:
                current: dict[str, BenchmarkCycle] = {}
                for arm in order:
                    key = f"{phase}{'' if repeat is None else repeat}_{arm}"
                    payload["phase"] = key
                    write()
                    current[arm] = collect(
                        engines[arm],
                        cases,
                        reference,
                        cuda,
                        key=key,
                        payload=payload,
                        write=write,
                        verify=verify,
                    )
                    if phase == "warmup":
                        warm[arm].append(current[arm])
                    elif phase == "pair":
                        measured[arm].append(current[arm])
                drift = compare_cycles(
                    (current["math"],), (current["efficient"],), QualityGate()
                )
                payload[f"{phase}{'' if repeat is None else repeat}_paired_drift"] = (
                    asdict(drift)
                )
                write()
                if not drift.passed:
                    raise ValueError("Paired arms fail unchanged quality gates")
            if mode == "confirm":
                profiled = cases[:batch_size]
                for arm in ("math", "efficient"):
                    payload["phase"] = f"{arm}_profile"
                    occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid())
                    write()
                    cycle, observed = profile_batch(scorers[arm], profiled, name=arm)
                    payload[f"{arm}_profile_cycle"] = cycle_data(cycle)
                    payload[f"{arm}_profile"] = observed
                    cast(dict[str, list[str]], payload["unknown_case_ids"])[
                        f"{arm}_profile"
                    ] = [
                        case.id
                        for case in profiled
                        if case.id not in {row.id for row in cycle.rows}
                    ]
                    passed, profile_drift = check_cycle(
                        cycle,
                        replace(reference, rows=reference.rows[:batch_size]),
                        replace(cuda, rows=cuda.rows[:batch_size]),
                    )
                    payload[f"{arm}_profile_drift"] = profile_drift
                    write()
                    if not passed:
                        raise ValueError("Representative profile quality failed")
                payload["dispatch_passed"] = efficient_dispatch_gate(
                    cast(dict[str, object], payload["efficient_profile"]),
                    batch_size=batch_size,
                    length=max(
                        len(base.encode_request(case.request).ids) for case in profiled
                    ),
                )
                if payload["dispatch_passed"] is not True:
                    raise ValueError("Representative efficient dispatch is unsupported")
            else:
                left, right = tuple(measured["math"]), tuple(measured["efficient"])
                report = BenchmarkReport(
                    INPUT_SHA,
                    cases,
                    BenchmarkProtocol(repeats=6, warmup=1),
                    engines["math"],
                    engines["efficient"],
                    left,
                    right,
                    compare_cycles(left, right, QualityGate()),
                    tuple(warm["math"]),
                    tuple(warm["efficient"]),
                ).to_dict()
                cast(dict[str, object], report["protocol"])["timing"] = payload[
                    "timing_scope"
                ]
                payload.update(report=report, performance=performance(left, right))
                payload["performance_passed"] = cast(
                    dict[str, object], payload["performance"]
                )["passed"]
            payload["occupancy_after"] = occupancy(own_pid=os.getpid())
            payload["cuda_memory"] = {
                "peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
                "peak_reserved_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(),
            }
        admit_attention(ROOT / ATTENTION_DECLARATION, ATTENTION_SHA)
        if (
            admit(manifest) != admission
            or admit_sources(sources, sources_sha256) != new_hashes
            or any(digest(ROOT / path) != sha for path, sha in history.items())
            or digest(control) != pinned["sha256"]
            or digest(Path(cast(str, pinned["wall_path"]))) != pinned["wall_sha256"]
            or any(digest(Path(item.path)) != item.sha256 for item in frozen.files)
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Consumed source/reference/history changed during execution"
            )
        payload.update(
            completed=True,
            quality_passed=True,
            phase="completed",
            worker_body_wall_ms=(time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6,
            torch_build=torch.__config__.show(),
        )
        write()
        return mode == "confirm" or payload["performance_passed"] is True
    except Exception as error:
        payload.update(
            completed=False,
            quality_passed=False,
            dispatch_passed=False,
            performance_passed=False,
            accepted=False,
            phase="failed",
            error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}",
        )
        write()
        return False
